use_case_name: Update the Facility Map and Displayed Devices

claims.content: The System Administrator updates the facility map and modifies the set of devices displayed on the GUI without requiring programming effort.

goal.raw_text: The System Administrator updates the facility map and modifies the set of devices displayed on the GUI without requiring programming effort.

claims.content: System Administrator
The System Administrator must be logged into the RLCS Software with System Administrative privileges to access the Configuration option.
The GUI must be operational and displaying the System Configuration Screen to allow modification of database tables related to the facility map and devices.
The System Administrator initiates a request to modify the facility map or change the set of devices displayed on the GUI.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates a request to modify the facility map or change the set of devices displayed on the GUI.

claims.content: The System Administrator accesses the System Configuration Screen via the GUI, which allows modification of database tables related to the facility map and devices.
The System Administrator modifies the facility map using the GUI options, which are designed to allow such modifications without requiring programming effort.
The System Administrator adds or removes devices from the display using the GUI options, which are designed to allow these changes without requiring programming effort.
When the system administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI shall analyze the data before storing in the database and notify the system administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries.

When the System Administrator modifies the database tables for the facility map or devices, the GUI shall analyze the data before storing it and notify the System Administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries.
The facility map has been successfully modified in the system without requiring programming effort.
The set of devices displayed on the GUI has been updated (added or removed) without requiring programming effort.
